listings.thesis: Power semis and power systems leverage; tight-supply, AI-adjacent, central-node.
listings.revisionNote: Balanced AI supply-chain exposure, but not as mispriced as the top residual-alpha names.

priorCase.rankRationale: Residual-alpha-vs-passives lens: power-semis + DC switchboard/power-supply capacity expansions (Malaysia, Tsukuba 1.7x, Kobe 1.5x) and SiC doubling are real bottleneck adjacency, but all predate June 9 and are already reflected. Bucketed 'secondary' - genuine adjacency, only modest mispricing. Hold rank 37.
